snapshot.title: docs: index verified hosted GUI evidence
snapshot.body:
Add a short index of the verified hosted GUI runs with exact SHA and scope boundaries.

This documentation-only PR is also the controlled no-GUI path for Issue #44's final gate verification. It has no workflow or application changes. Keep it open until #87 and #88 are deployed; then verify policy-derived GUI omission, current CI/review, Copilot final judgement, and opt-in automatic merge. Do not treat the old experiment runs as this PR's GUI evidence.
